newsitem.title: USA: Max & Erma's confident can meet revs goal.
newsitem.headline: Max & Erma's confident can meet revs goal.

text.p: Max & Erma's Restaurants Inc on Wednesday said it is confident that it can meet its goal of 15 percent revenue growth for the remainder of 1997.
The firm attributed the forecast to a series of new restaurants either under construction or opening soon.
The company said that at the end of the first quarter of 1997, two Max & Erma's restaurants were under construction in Atlanta, Georgia and one in Greenville, South Carolina.
A second quarter 1997 opening is planned for the two Atlanta restaurants. A unit in Greenville will open during the fourth quarter of 1997.
